content.short: iMe Messenger is a Telegram-based crypto messenger and DeFi platform enabling P2P crypto transfers, swaps, and wallet management in chat.
content.description: iMe is a feature-rich messaging application built on Telegram's infrastructure that integrates a full-featured DeFi wallet and crypto toolkit directly into the chat experience. Users can send and receive cryptocurrency in any chat conversation, access a built-in DEX for token swaps, manage their Web3 portfolio, and interact with DeFi protocols  all without leaving the messenger. iMe supports Mantle Network, allowing users to transact and interact with Mantle assets directly through their messaging interface.
content.meta: iMe Messenger integrates crypto wallets and DeFi swaps directly into a Telegram-based chat experience on Mantle. Discover iMe on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
